Package teilchen.constraint

Class LineCollider2D

java.lang.Object
teilchen.constraint.Collider
teilchen.constraint.LineCollider2D
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint
public class LineCollider2D extends Collider
keeps particles from passing through a line segment in the XY plane ( z is ignored ). the segment is two-sided, particles are deflected on the side they come from. particle radius is taken into account.
